gizmo.title: Umdwebo kusuka embhalweni
gizmo.description: Bhala umdwebo njengombhalo (Mermaid): ishadi lokugeleza, ukulandelana, umugqa wesikhathi nokunye. Udwetshwa ekhasini kanye nombhalo ongenye indlela.

configure.title: Isihloko
configure.description: Kuboniswa ngaphezu komdwebo futhi kusetshenziswa njengegama lawo.

configure.title: Umthombo womdwebo
configure.description: Umbhalo we-Mermaid, isibonelo: flowchart TD, bese umugqa owodwa ngesixhumanisi ngasinye njengo-A[Draft] --> B{Ready?}. Engeza |label| ngemva komcibisholo ukuze uwunike ilebula. Umdwebo uyabuyekezwa njengoba uthayipha.

configure.title: Enye indlela yombhalo
configure.description: Chaza lokho umdwebo okubonisayo kubantu abangakwazi ukuwubona. Shiya kungenalutho kushadi lokugeleza ukuze izinyathelo zalo zibhalwe ohlwini wena.

configure.title: Bonisa umbhalo ongenye indlela
configure.description: Bonisa umbhalo ongenye indlela ngaphansi komdwebo. Uhlala utholakala kubafundi besikrini.

advanced.title: Ifayela lomthombo
advanced.description: Ikheli lefayela le-.mmd okufanele lidwetshwe esikhundleni sombhalo ongenhla (https noma indlela kule sayithi).
